package.name: devsweep-inspect
package.upstream_inspiration: avdlee/xcode-disk-cleanup-agent-skill; orzcls/win-disk-cleaner; az9713/claude-skill-disk-cleanup; heyzgj/storage-cleanup-skill; thearmagan/skills@dry-run-first; affaan-m/ECC@config-gc; vinta/awesome-python@preview-verdicts

intent.description:
Inspect this machine with the globally installed DevSweep CLI and return
cleanup or optimization advice for developer caches and disk space. Use when
the user asks to 检查本机, 磁盘清理建议, 释放空间, 开发缓存, or 优化建议; or
says inspect disk space, developer cache, recommend cleanup, or optimization
advice. Also use for 帮我清理, 执行清理, 确认后清理, or clean selected
Cleanup Targets. Show the cleanup list and wait for confirmation before
clean execute. Call PATH `devsweep.exe`, never cargo run of this repository.
Do not use for software uninstall, TUI work, just ci, rm -rf, or PowerShell
Remove-Item.
intent.job_to_be_done: Inspect this machine with the globally installed DevSweep CLI, recommend cleanup, and execute a confirmed Cleanup Plan without using this repository as the cleaner.
target_users: coding agents working in the DevSweep repository
developers who ask an agent to inspect disk space or clean developer caches
inputs: natural-language inspect, advice, or cleanup request
optional scan roots, scope, and risk filter
explicit confirmation of a displayed Cleanup Target list
outputs: selectable cleanup list that waits for confirmation
optional new observation, plan, preview, or execution JSON
exclusions: same-turn clean execute before a displayed list is confirmed
cargo run of this repository as the cleaner

should_trigger: 检查本机，给出磁盘清理建议
看看开发缓存占了多少 disk space
recommend cleanup for this machine, inspect disk space first
给出优化建议，并检查本机开发缓存
Use DevSweep to inspect disk space and return cleanup advice
本机开发缓存太大，先给我清理建议和释放空间估计
帮我清理风险为low和medium的路径
确认清理这些 Cleanup Target
执行清理，run clean execute now
near_neighbor: rm -rf node_modules and Remove-Item the cache
cargo run --locked -p devsweep-cli --bin devsweep -- clean execute

compact_workflow: Resolve the program with `python scripts/resolve_devsweep.py --repo-root <repo>`. Use that absolute PATH binary. Never `cargo run -p devsweep-cli` and never `target\\debug\\devsweep.exe` or `target\\release\\devsweep.exe` from this checkout.

Route inspect with [references/cli-playbook.md](references/cli-playbook.md). Default to `clean scan --scope all --format json --output <new-file>` plus explicit `--root` values. Do not default `--root .` when cwd is this repository.
Keep program and argv separate. Do not compose a shell cleanup string.

Read the JSON result. Build the recommendation report from [references/recommendation-report.md](references/recommendation-report.md). Use Cleanup Target, Scan Report, Cleanup Plan, Estimated Recoverable, and Inspect Only.
If the user asked only for advice, stop after the report. Omit execute argv.

If the user asked to clean, follow [references/confirmed-clean.md](references/confirmed-clean.md): list selectable ids, display the table, wait for confirmation, then `clean plan` / `clean preview` / `clean execute`.
output_contract: Name the inspect command, the global binary, and the roots that actually ran.
Split Estimated Recoverable into verified, partial-lower-bound, and unknown.
Table Cleanup Targets with id, path, evidence, risk, class, and advice `recommend` / `inspect-only` / `exclude`.
Call out Inspect Only rows, including Cargo home.
Treat Optimize list rows as catalogue facts, not completed maintenance.
For inspect-only requests, end without execute argv.
For cleanup requests, display the full selectable list and wait. Do not run `clean execute` in the same turn as the first list.

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow catalog metadata and read-only source review; forbid unreviewed execution

permissions.file_write: optional new observation, ids, untrusted plan, preview, or execution JSON via DevSweep --output create-new
permissions.subprocess: globally installed DevSweep CLI plus this skill's Python helpers; never cargo run of this repo
permissions.interactive: required for cleanup confirmation; avoid for inspect-only advice

scaffold: README hook and natural trigger examples

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
